items.title: InCred Capital Acquires Quintessentially India to Expand Services
items.subject: Quintessentially
items.why: InCred, a KKR portfolio company, is buying Quintessentially in India or ANZ: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the KKR deal team covering InCred: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: Ingenia Communities (ASX: INA) Enters Non-Exclusive Process with AVID and Warburg Pincus as ACCC Clears Peet Acquisition
items.subject: Ingenia Communities Enters
items.why: Warburg Pincus is in a live process for Ingenia Communities Enters in India or ANZ: bids are moving and the diligence window is open.
items.call: Call the Warburg Pincus India or ANZ deal team now: confirmatory tech DD, and a red-flag view on the stack if they are not yet in exclusivity.

items.title: Watch EQT Sees “Wave” of Take-Private Opportunities in Japan
items.subject: Sees Wave
items.why: EQT has agreed to buy Sees Wave in North Asia: buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the EQT deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.subject: Cube

items.title: Centerbridge agrees Canopius exit to Samsung Fire & Marine, KKR and KIC
items.subject: Centerbridge
items.why: KKR has agreed to sell Centerbridge in Asia: VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and KKR has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the KKR team on what the proceeds go into next.
